pages.title: Cyclone Senyar — rain forecast for AP

facts.text: IMD: heavy rain in Coastal AP and Rayalaseema 29 Nov – 2 Dec 2025 from two low-pressure systems over Bay of Bengal
facts.head: News

facts.text: System 1: over Strait of Malacca & south Andaman Sea; System 2: near Comorin / SW Bay / Sri Lanka — may interact/merge
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Senyar / Senyari — suggested by UAE, meaning "Lion" (not Sri Lanka)
facts.head: Name

facts.text: ⚠ Second major post-monsoon Bay of Bengal cyclone of 2025 after Cyclone Montha (Oct 2025)
facts.head: Name

pages.title: Hayli Gubbi volcano erupts after ~12,000 years

facts.text: Volcano: Hayli Gubbi, north-eastern Ethiopia (near Red Sea, Afar Rift)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Erupted: 23 November 2025 — ⚠ first in nearly 12,000 years
facts.head: News

facts.text: Type: explosive — ash and gases, no lava flows
facts.head: News

facts.text: Ash plume: via Arabian Peninsula, Arabian Sea → Gujarat, Rajasthan → Delhi, UP → towards China; at 10–14 km altitude — flights disrupted
facts.head: News

facts.text: Alerts: Volcanic Ash Advisory Centres (VAACs)
facts.head: News

facts.text: IUCN assessment at IUCN World Conservation Congress, Abu Dhabi (2025) flagged threats to Indian dugongs (Gulf of Kutch, Andaman & Nicobar)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Study (Marine Pollution Bulletin): arsenic, cadmium, chromium, mercury, lead in 46 stranded dugongs
facts.head: News

facts.text: Dugong dugon — "sea cow"; ⚠ only herbivorous marine mammal in India; eats seagrass (30–40 kg/day)
facts.head: Species facts

facts.text: Size: ~3 m, ~420 kg; lives up to 70 years; matures at 9–10 years; calves every 3–5 years
facts.head: Species facts

facts.text: Seagrass: Cymodocea, Halophila, Thalassia, Halodule; depth <10 m
